name: tau_escape
caption: Confirmatory S12 estimand: tau_escape on the L0 clock (lock at 0.75 turnover, horizon 12.0), censored at the cohort T_min of 4999168 tokens. A false confirmed_escape_through_tmin means no confirmed escape through T_min.
limitations: This is not a last-band G_t and it is not a claim that the lock is permanent. The continuation flags are concatenated after the L0 F1 looping series from the published degeneracy runs. T_min is the shortest cell in this cohort, so a later escape on a longer cell is censored. One local GPU, eight continuations, N_confirm=3 unchanged.
